author_or_institution: Erik Brynjolfsson; Danielle Li; Lindsey Raymond
title: Generative AI at Work
source_type: Peer-reviewed field study in the Quarterly Journal of Economics
book_use: Evidence from 5,172 customer-support agents that AI assistance increased issues resolved per hour by about 15% on average, with larger gains for less-experienced and lower-skilled workers, evidence of faster movement down the experience curve and worker learning, and smaller or mixed effects for the most experienced workers.
